title: Trump Administration Moves to Block China From Indirect Access to American AI Technology
description: The Trump administration issued new rules to restrict indirect access by China and other countries to advanced U.S. AI computing technology. The rules require overseas data centers serving countries like China, Russia, Iran, and Cuba to identify their end users and impose case-by-case licensing for chip sales to certain Southeast Asian and Latin American countries. This aims to close loopholes allowing China to use U.S. AI chips remotely via cloud computing, which previously circumvented export controls.
